subject: Cockeyed squid
topic: Half a kilometer down off the US West Coast, a squid with mismatched eyes tiptoes across the seafloor.
script:
Half a kilometer down off the US West Coast, a squid with mismatched eyes tiptoes across the seafloor.
This is a cock-eyed squid.
Its left eye is at least twice as big as its right one.
Scientists think each eye has its own job.
The big eye looks up, searching for faint shadows against the last light from the surface.
The small eye looks down, watching for flashes from glowing animals below.
Two eyes, two completely different views of the dark.
After a short walk on its arms, this one drifted away.
Which eye would you trust down here?
pkg_title: This Squid Has One GIANT Eye and One Tiny Eye 👀 #Shorts
